key_idea: A sticker put down later lies on top of a sticker put down earlier.
steps: First the triangle, then the heart, then the diamond.
So the triangle must be under the heart, and the heart must be under the diamond.
In picture B the heart lies on top of the triangle, and the diamond lies on top of the heart.
In every other picture one of these is the wrong way round.

choice_feedback.A: Here the triangle lies on top of the heart, but the triangle went down first.
choice_feedback.C: Here the heart lies on top of the diamond, but the diamond went down last.
choice_feedback.D: Here the heart lies on top of the diamond, but the diamond went down last.
choice_feedback.E: Here the heart lies on top of the diamond, but the diamond went down last.
